cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Don't call the taxi yet. We're packed, but we haven't settled last night. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised for telling my sister about your debt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Stay a minute. I can't face her checking what I order tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's already paid for dinner. We'll be late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll be late. Sit with me and help me believe you're coming as my partner, not to report how grateful I am.
